//: Human review ledger — a record of what a person checked against the PRINTED page, and nothing more. This file confers NO authority on any record. It does not verify anything, it is not read by the app, the Worker, or the importer, and no code path grants a record trust because it appears here. Verification in Firestore is a separate, deliberate act performed by an admin in the app, and it has not happened for any record listed below. The ledger exists so that act is traceable afterwards: who looked, at which printed page, at which edition, and at exactly which bytes of text.
notes: reviewedTextHash is sha256(text.ar + U+0000 + text.en) over the source-pack record AS IT STANDS. It is the same construction the admin screen uses for contentHash, so a reviewed record whose text is later edited can be detected: the ledger hash stops matching the pack.
A ledger entry pinned to a hash means: 'a human reviewed THESE bytes'. It says nothing about any other bytes.

reviewedPages is present only when a record spans more than one printed page, and must list exactly the pages its own sourceSection names. A record that spans pages 96-97 may not be recorded as though only page 96 was read.

A record may pass its TEXT review and still be held back from import. That is recorded as deploymentBlocked with a deploymentBlockReason, never as reviewStatus "blocked" — blocked is reserved for a problem with the text itself, and using it for a product limitation would wrongly suggest the religious text is at fault.

reviews.sourceReferencesNote: تصحيح بيانات لا نص. كان السجل يحمل «صحيح البخاري 1540»، وهو منسوب خطأً من وجهين: الصفحة تطبع في الحاشية (1) رقم 1545 لا 1540، وعلامة تلك الحاشية موضوعة على الفقرة السابقة المنتهية عند «قَلَّدَهَا» (حديث ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما، ممتدة من ص73)، لا على هذا السجل. أما الحاشية الموضوعة داخل هذا السجل فهي (2) عند «شقه الأيسر» = مسلم 1305. فحُذف مرجع البخاري ولم يُستبدل برقم آخر، ولم يُنقل إلى سجل غيره: الفقرة صاحبة الحاشية (1) غير ممثَّلة في الحزمة أصلًا، فأُدرج المرجع في تقرير الفجوات لا في سجل. وبقي مرجع ﴿الفتح: 27﴾ لأنه مطبوع داخل نص السجل نفسه بين معقوفتين، لا في حاشية. نص السجل (text.ar) لم يتغير، وهاش النص كما هو.
